title: Pricing Committee Schedule — Autopay Discount Offered by Remaining Term, Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Schedule.** The autopay discount offered on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans enrolment depends on the whole months remaining from the enrolment date to the maturity date: none when fewer than 12 remain, 0.20 point, or the product's autopay rate discount when that is smaller, when 12 to 47 remain, and the product's autopay rate discount when 48 or more remain.

| Whole months from the enrolment date to the maturity date on record | Autopay discount offered |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | none |
| 12 to 47 | 0.20 point, or the product's autopay rate discount when that is smaller |
| 48 or more | the product's autopay rate discount |

## Both sides of each line

| Whole months remaining | Offered (product autopay discount 0.25) |
|---|---|
| 11 | none |
| 12 | 0.20 |
| 47 | 0.20 |
| 48 | 0.25 |

## Points of judgement

- On a product whose autopay rate discount is 0.25, the middle band offers 0.20, the smaller of the two.
- On a product whose autopay rate discount is zero, every band offers none.
- Whole months are counted from the enrolment date to the maturity date on the loan record; a part month does not count.
